policy: The overlay only displays the exact text Loading...... on a clean translucent dark-gray shade. Atmosphere is limited to a low-opacity game-icon watermark, subtle red breathing glow, sparse embers, text breathing, and an edge vignette. It never displays a map name, region description, tip, progress bar, or gameplay status.

atmosphere.background: cool near-black charcoal blue at approximately 90 percent coverage and 10 percent scene visibility
atmosphere.blackBackgroundRemoval: brightness mask plus elliptical edge feathering in the watermark shader

viewportCoverage.shadeAndVignette: cover the complete renderable viewport including pixels outside display safe-area insets
viewportCoverage.safeContent: game icon, glow, embers, and Loading text remain inside the display safe area

integrationLifecycle: Call GameHUD.begin_loading_transition(transition_id) before changing the active map.
Wait for GameHUD.loading_transition_covered(request) with the same transition_id before unloading or loading gameplay content.
After the new map has produced its first process and render frame, call GameHUD.finish_loading_transition().
Ignore stale callbacks and prevent overlapping map transitions in the gameplay coordinator.
